units.source_text: 却说留在紫儿邸宅里的众侍女，担心兵部卿亲王来问时没有话可以回答，大家很忧愁。

en.t: Meanwhile, the maidservants who remained at Murasaki's residence were deeply worried, fearing they would have nothing to say if Prince Hyobukyo came to question them.

units.source_text: 源氏公子临走时，曾叮嘱她们“暂时不要告诉别人”。

en.t: When Lord Genji left, he had instructed them, "Do not tell anyone for the time being."

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母也对她们这么说。

en.t: Shonagon, the nurse, had told them the same thing as well.

units.source_text: 因此众侍女都严守秘密。

en.t: For that reason, all the maidservants guarded the secret strictly.

units.source_text: 兵部卿问时，她们只说“少纳言乳母带她逃出去躲避了，去向不明”。

en.t: When Prince Hyobukyo asked, they only said, "Shonagon, the nurse, took her away to hide, and her whereabouts are unknown."

units.source_text: 兵部卿没有办法，心中猜想：“已故的老尼姑竭力反对送她到父亲处，少纳言乳母体念老太太的心愿，因此干了这越分的行为。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo could do nothing, and thought to himself, "The late old nun strongly opposed sending her to her father's house, and Shonagon, the nurse, mindful of the old lady's wishes, has therefore taken this presumptuous action.

units.source_text: 她不好意思公开声言姑娘不便去父亲处，便自作主张悄悄地带她逃出去躲避了。”

en.t: She must have felt unable to state openly that the girl should not go to her father, so she acted on her own and secretly took her away to hide."
He had no choice but to wipe away his tears and return home.

units.source_text: 临行时吩咐道：“倘探得了姑娘去处，立刻来报告。”

en.t: As he was leaving, he ordered, "If you discover where the girl has gone, report it to me at once."
All the maidservants felt terribly troubled.
